title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: We demonstrate that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning
abstract: We explore generating a chain of thought to significantly improve the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning.

title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
abstract: We develop and release Llama 2, a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models ranging in scale from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
abstract: We propose a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation.

title: A Survey on Large Language Models
abstract: This survey reviews the recent advances of LLMs by introducing the background, key findings, and mainstream techniques.

title: The Pile: An 800GB Dataset of Diverse Text for Language Modeling
abstract: We present the Pile, a large and diverse dataset suitable for training large language models.
